name: ServiceNow (NOW)
teaser: ServiceNow earns $4.6 billion of free cash flow and pays $2.2 billion of it in stock. At $140.86 the price equals my Bull case, 31% above Base $107.52. Hold; the buy zone starts at $59.14.
llms: Enterprise workflow software platform (IT, customer and employee service, security, AI agents) with 97% subscription revenue. Valued on a two-stage cash flow model of owner free cash flow after stock-based compensation, cross-checked with a forward multiple. Bear $51.88, Base $107.52, Bull $141.62. Verdict HOLD at $140.86; maximum buy price $59.14 at a required margin of safety of 45%.
